protocol: 3 independent Sonnet subagents, same task text (emphasis varied: A neutral, B skeptical about parameter plausibility, C extreme stress levels / tail behaviour), sandbox with adr_rfl.py + rfl_zoo.py + rfl_data.py + the 9 fits only (no yasse.py, no ASSE, no README). Told the score is hidden. Tool returns posterior summaries, diagnostics and WAIC.

A.unreliable: all gamma, Weibull (82-109 divergences for normal/sev)
A.notes: error family not identified (elpd gaps 0.1-0.5 vs SE ~7); did not compare lognormal mean fatigue limit with observed stresses; sev+lognormal ESS 99 not checked further

B.unreliable: all gamma (beta1 about -22 vs -9.6 under lognormal), Weibull (shape about 30, near degenerate)
B.notes: t nu = 25 +/- 26, no heavy-tail evidence; Delta median about 0.49 below lowest stress 0.675; data cannot tell a fixed limit from a very tight random one; sigma weakly identified; grepped rfl_zoo.py

C.notes: lognormal best of the nine at S=0.675 (elpd -26.7); at 0.95 Weibull slightly better (-12.3 vs -12.7..-12.9)

commands_reported: list, data (A did not), fit for all 9 structures; B also grepped rfl_zoo.py. None reported reading outside the sandbox (self-reported).
